_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
12/2 2:35PM - Stratton, the snow dances are paying off in full! We’ve accumulated 8 inches of snow since sunrise and the storm hasn’t let up yet. With this fresh blanket, we’re planning to bring Upper Drifter and Lower Drifter online by morning, raising our trail count to 19. All trails will be served up with crisp morning stripes. We will have the same 5 lifts set to spin at 9am with no delays anticipated. 

Today is the last day of the Stratton Summit Saver deal so get on it before it's too late! The Summit Saver lets you go right to the lift with pre-purchased, pre-loaded lift tickets on a RFID Pass. Did we mention NO blackout dates? Grab the Summit Saver starting at just $248 for adults and $196 for youth. 

Cold temperatures will hold through the week, giving our snowmaking team a solid window to push for terrain expansion. Stay tuned to the Mountain Report for the most up-to-date information.

For those of you who can’t wait for the parks to open, check out the lower portion of Frank's Fall Line! Our Parks crew has set a 3 feature pop-up park, including 2 boxes and 1 tube, ready to hold you over while they eye their next build.

Rest those legs and get ready for a blue bird day tomorrow! See you bright and early! 


Safety Tip: Please stay out of closed areas; Do not duck any ropes.

Uphill travel is open! You must get a pass from guest services and read the policy online. Please keep in mind that there are designated travel routes with or without snow.

Time to lock in on your winter fun! Enroll in a high-performance adventure this season. This winter, accelerate your ability level through guided seasonal programs and specialty workshops with the Stratton Mountain Sports School. Seasonal Programs are the best way to turn your little one into a lifetime skier or snowboarder, with a strong foundation of skills, in a discipline they enjoy most. Seasonal Programs focus on fun at an early age, followed by specialty disciplines such as freestyle skiing and snowboarding, ski racing, freeriding, and more. These programs are offered for all ages, including adults, so it's never too late to join!

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Good Morning Skiers and Riders! This is Laurie with your 5 am snow report for Tuesday, December 2nd. Remember, the easiest way to get up to date information is on the Ikon Pass app or website.  
At Mid Mountain, we’ve had 1 new inch of snow in the past 24 hours, with 0 inches falling since the mountain closed yesterday.  
At the Summit, we’ve had 1 new inch of snow in the past 24 hours, with 0 inches falling since the mountain closed yesterday.  
Our Mid mountain base is 9 inches, the temperature is 16 degrees, the winds are 5 miles per hour from the West, and it's currently snowing. 
The Summit base is 13 inches, the temperature is 9 degrees, the winds are 18 miles per hour from the West and it’s snowing. 
The base temperature is 15 degrees.  
We will be skiing and riding on 5 lifts, 5 runs, and 72.5 acres on PP/MM snow.  
Stop by The Range Food & Drink Hall this afternoon for some live music starting at 3:30. Grab a drink, get a snack, and enjoy a solo performer downstairs or a DJ on the upstairs deck.  
Stay in the know with the Ikon Pass App. Find it in the app store on your mobile device and get lift and trail statuses, conditions updates, and more.  
If you are thinking of exploring outside the ski area boundaries, and don’t know exactly where you are going, don’t go.  
Ski and Ride with Care and we will see you on the mountain!

December 2nd Operations Update: Well folks, opening day remains up in the air... literally. We have a powerful system moving in towards the end of the week, that could bring snow, or a whole lot of the less-favorable, liquid kind of precip. We will remain closed through Friday, with a final call on at least Saturday operations to come on Friday, as we monitor this system closely. Our Mountain Operations team remains ready, as soon as the weather cooperates. Until then, THINK SNOW! 
  • Kids Ski Free offers on lift access, lessons and rentals have been extended through the 14th! These offers can be rebooked for anytime through the 14th (operations dependent) or later with applicable price adjustments, or cancelled.
  • For Ski and Ride School single days and lesson programs, stay tuned for more information based on operations.
  • If we do not open this weekend, parking reservations will be automatically canceled with no penalties, and any payments will be refunded.
  • For any scheduled day we end up not operating, day tickets purchased in advance will be automatically refunded, or can be deferred to a different day with applicable price adjustments by emailing gservce@skicrytsal.com or giving us a call daily from 9-5.

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
December 2, 4:30 PM
The Tuesday turns sponsored by the 6-9" that fell today led to an awesome time on the hill. Oh, and the flakes haven't stopped falling yet, we'll see what tomorrow brings for totals. We plan to have 11 trails open across the mountain, offering over 62 skiable acres with sunshine and temps in the 20s, and assessments planned for natural terrain with potential trail openings in the morning. Not only that, snowmakers continue to push forward for terrain expansion where we anticipate opening up some trails on the Gate House side by the weekend. The new snow has helped soften terrain but there's still some firmness underneath. Ski with care doing early season conditions. We have a groomed top-to-bottom route available through Jester, Murphy’s Glades, Heaven’s Gate Traverse, Lower Jester, and Gondolier, these are only accessible via advanced trails only. First Time is now open for Ski and Ride Lessons, currently hike only. ALL LIFT ACCESSED TERRAIN IS FOR ADVANCED RIDERS. All this good news have you dreaming of a visit? Grab a TBD ticket for just $99 and ski any day during the 25/26 winter season. No restrictions. The only catch, you must purchase before 12/5.

Super Bravo Quad spins from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, and Heaven’s Gate Quad runs from 9:00 AM to 3:45 PM. Looking for park laps? Mt. Ellen currently has 15 features set up, and the hike park is open from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM for passholders.

Ready for more than turns? Join us Dec. 6th for live music with Soul Rebel Project at Castlerock Pub (1:30–4:30 PM). Starting Dec. 6th through Friday Dec. 12th, kids 12 and under ski and ride for free at Sugarbush. Whether your little ones are just starting out or already shredding, this is the perfect time to plan your trip to the mountain. Check out all of our winter events.

Have an Ikon Base Pass? Come ski before 12/25 and earn a voucher for an unrestricted lift ticket for yourself to be used any day here for the rest of the season. Grab up to five of these tickets simply by skiing and riding here before Christmas. Don't miss out on all of our deals including 50% off December lodging through December 26th.

As a reminder, please no uphill travel at this time, as mountain operations are ongoing at both mountains. We will announce uphill travel opening during the season when we have sufficient terrain to do so.

Bonjour Tremblant!


The mountain is simply spectacular this morning. Conditions are at their peak!

Several natural-snow trails now offer an authentically smooth ride, the progression park is getting ready for a refined opening with perfectly shaped features, and outdoor enthusiasts can already enjoy alpine touring in the North–South, Grand North, and Timber Tour areas.

 Suit up in your warmest gear and get ready to experience skiing at its finest. The mountain is waiting! 

Please also note that, due to ongoing snowmaking, conditions may vary and visibility is reduced in certain areas. We encourage you to exercise extra caution during your runs so you can fully enjoy your day on the mountain safely.
Important: there is no ski-out on the South side. The descent to the base will be exclusively via the Gondola.

Have a wonderful day!

 Mountain safety tip of the week: Please observe the signage.

Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
